findings.title: 联系人 stop 被记成用户取消，actor.kind 与实际动作方不符
call_chain: Host.commitRound action stop at host.ts:2881-2889 checks owner contact
eventActor treats every Cancel as user at task-timeline.ts:37
findings.trigger: Owner contact emits existing MindAction {kind:stop, taskId} for its running task. This is an ordinary authorized product route, not a private method call.
findings.observed: Real Host/service/SQLite probe completed T3_Running -> T9_StopRequested -> T10_Cancelled; tasks.timeline returned cause=Cancel actor={kind:user,id:<contactId>} although issued action came from that contact.
findings.expected: The actual contact actor must remain kind=contact (or explicit origin carrying that real actor); never invent a user with a contact ID.
findings.impact: The new append-only authoritative task fact stream misattributes an actual actor, so clients cannot truthfully distinguish contact termination from user cancellation.
findings.existing_vs_new: Existing stop behavior succeeds and was not changed; wrong persisted timeline actor is newly introduced by this slice.
findings.suggested_minimal_boundary: Supply contact origin at the existing contact stop call or otherwise preserve typed actor context; do not infer user solely from TaskEvent.kind.

findings.title: 联系人自主自动重跑被归给从未发起重跑的本机用户
call_chain: MindAction rerun basisSeq=null leaves req.initiator=contact and trigger=auto at host.ts:2894-2908
rerunTx receives both typed initiator and actor at host.ts:1853-1855
new RerunCreate and RerunClaim hardcode {kind:user,id:this.userId} at host.ts:1906-1907
findings.trigger: Owner contact reacts to a failed Compute session with {kind:rerun,runId,roomId,basisSeq:null}; rerun policy permits its one automatic attempt.
findings.observed: Real public task creation -> controlled Compute failure -> ordinary contact rerun action created a new task. Existing gg_run_events rerun detail correctly recorded initiator=contact, actor=contact, trigger=auto, basisSeq=null; the new task timeline RerunCreate and RerunClaim instead both recorded actor={kind:user,id:actual-user}.
findings.expected: Automatic contact rerun must not synthesize a user initiator/actor. Reuse the already available typed req.initiator/req.actor according to the chosen timeline actor semantics.
findings.impact: The new task history falsely asserts a user-triggered creation/claim and contradicts the existing durable run ledger, changing product truth for autonomous retries.
findings.existing_vs_new: Existing run ledger and automatic rerun route retain correct contact provenance; the new history rows introduce the contradiction.
findings.suggested_minimal_boundary: Derive the two origin actors from rerunTx req rather than this.userId; retain explicit/manual rerun behavior and do not rewrite rerun policy.
